name: opencode-lib-context
body:
The shared plumbing's opencode 2.x context adaptation: `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts` sources the plugin's load location from the plugin context (`ctx.location.directory`, `ctx.location.project`) and keeps the tool's own optional `directory` argument authoritative for the project-root walk-up (`ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.findApgRoot`) and the stored-identity rebasing (`requirements.requirement.absolute-paths-at-tool-boundary`). The pure `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.fsScopeDecision` decision resolves a path's boundary in one frame, pinned by the plugin-free unit test. The acting agent's identity and its effective `edit` scope come from the opencode 2.x tool executor context and its permission surface — the mechanism `requirements.constraint.agent-fs-per-path-permission` states — and an unresolvable acting agent refuses every path.

implemented-by: `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts`, `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.ToolContext`, `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.readAgentEditGlobs`, `opencode-suite/lib/apg.test.ts`.
